title: Open Form Spec (OFS)
description: Declarative specification for form field state rules. Defines whether fields are required, optional, or forbidden based on form values and external context.

section.description: Section identifier. Must match the form section name (e.g. 'registration').

dto.description: Reference to the OpenAPI DTO schema name (e.g. 'Registration').

imports.description: External references used in field conditions.

enums.description: Enum imports. Maps a local alias to an OpenAPI schema reference in the format 'source#SchemaName' (e.g. 'api#AccountType').

context.description: External data available during validation that is not part of the form section itself (e.g. app configuration, user info).

fields.description: Field definitions with state rules. Keys must match DTO property names.

fieldState.description: required = must have a value, optional = may have a value, forbidden = must not have a value (field is hidden and cleared).

contextProperty.description: A property within a context object.

type.description: Primitive type of this context property.

enum.description: Reference to an imported enum alias. Mutually exclusive with 'type'.

field.description: A form field definition with its base state and optional conditional state changes.

state.description: Default state when no 'when' condition matches.

when.description: Conditions that override the base state. Evaluated in order — first match wins. If none match, 'state' applies.

fields.description: Nested field definitions for object-typed fields (e.g. address sub-fields).

whenEntry.description: A condition that changes a field's state. Either a simple condition or a compound condition using 'all'.

simpleWhen.description: A single condition. Must specify exactly one source (field, context, or section+field) and one comparator (is, isNot, in, notIn).

field.description: Field name in the same section. Use dot notation for nested fields (e.g. 'address.street').

section.description: Section name for cross-section field references. Must be used together with 'field'.

context.description: Dot-notation path to a context property (e.g. 'config.requirePhone').

is.description: Value must be strictly equal to this. Supports literals (true, false, numbers, strings) and enum references (e.g. 'AccountType.BUSINESS').

isNot.description: Value must not be strictly equal to this.

in.description: Value must be one of these values.

notIn.description: Value must not be one of these values.

then.description: The state to apply when this condition matches.

compoundWhen.description: Multiple conditions that must ALL match (logical AND).

all.description: All conditions must match for this entry to apply.

then.description: The state to apply when all conditions match.

conditionExpr.description: A single condition expression within a compound 'all' block.

field.description: Field name in the same section.

section.description: Section name for cross-section field references.

context.description: Dot-notation path to a context property.

is.description: Value must be strictly equal to this.

isNot.description: Value must not be strictly equal to this.

in.description: Value must be one of these values.

notIn.description: Value must not be one of these values.
